

VERIFIED TERMINOLOGY FOR THIS PASS:
A note is what the author of this book knows about the term that the source
text does not state outright — gender, age, role, which of two similar names it
is. Follow every note. A note is never translated and never appears in your
output.
- "Grunnings" => "Граннингс" (use this target form exactly)
- "Rom" => "Rom" (use this lexical choice; grammatical inflection is allowed) — author’s note: c’est un garçon de huit ans
These constraints apply regardless of the source and target languages.
